subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should this lineage stack be accepted as legacy-default shadow infrastructure now, and what accuracy evidence must be mandatory before its authority token can be used in production?
rationale: The patch is technically guarded and well tested, but it deliberately creates a future path to replace persisted accounting totals despite material daily residuals and no fixed accuracy floor; that acceptance threshold is a product and compatibility choice.

options.title: Land shadow infrastructure
options.body: Merge the stack in order with legacy authority and rollback preserved, while separately blocking production promotion until broader day-level validation passes an agreed threshold.

options.title: Define a numeric gate first
options.body: Require the promotion evaluator to enforce maintainer-approved daily and aggregate accuracy bounds before accepting the stack.

options.title: Pause the lineage stack
options.body: Keep the current containment only until the ledger reaches closer parity on additional real histories.

recommendation.title: Land shadow infrastructure
recommendation.body: Merge the stack in order with legacy authority and rollback preserved, while separately blocking production promotion until broader day-level validation passes an agreed threshold.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner merged and validated the current accounting containment and is the strongest available owner for the compatibility threshold.
